mapper.sql: m.id, m.session_day_id, m.organization_id, m.corp_id, m.wecom_msg_id, m.message_direction, m.sender_userid, m.sender_external_userid, m.peer_userid, m.chat_type, m.external_userid, m.roomid, m.matched_external_userid, m.msg_type, m.content_text, m.send_time, m.extra_json, CASE WHEN m.follow_record_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.follow_record_id) != '' AND f.id IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE COALESCE(m.status, 'PENDING') END AS status, CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE m.follow_record_id END AS follow_record_id, m.error_message, m.create_time, m.update_user, COALESCE(m.update_time, s.update_time) AS update_time
mapper.select: SELECT id AS sessionKey, chat_type AS chatType, roomid, last_send_time AS lastSendTime FROM wecom_ingestion_session_day WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} ORDER BY last_send_time DESC, update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT
FROM wecom_ingestion_message m JOIN wecom_ingestion_session_day s ON s.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.session_day_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN follow_up_record f ON f.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.follow_record_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND f.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.session_day_id = #{sessionKey} AND LOWER(COALESCE(m.msg_type, '')) != 'revoke' AND (m.follow_record_id IS NULL OR TRIM(m.follow_record_id) = '' OR f.id IS NULL) ORDER BY m.send_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT
FROM wecom_ingestion_message m JOIN wecom_ingestion_session_day s ON s.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.session_day_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN follow_up_record f ON f.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.follow_record_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND f.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY m.send_time ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO wecom_ingestion_message_follow_record (id, organization_id, message_id, follow_record_id, create_user, create_time) VALUES
(REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), #{organizationId}, #{messageId}, #{followRecordId}, #{operatorUserId}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE wecom_ingestion_session_day s SET s.status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wecom_ingestion_message m WHERE m.session_day_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = #{sessionDayId} COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND LOWER(COALESCE(m.msg_type, '')) != 'revoke' AND ( m.follow_record_id IS NULL OR TRIM(m.follow_record_id) = '' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follow_up_record f WHERE f.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.follow_record_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND f.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci ) ) ) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END, s.follow_record_id = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wecom_ingestion_message m WHERE m.session_day_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = #{sessionDayId} COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND LOWER(COALESCE(m.msg_type, '')) != 'revoke' AND ( m.follow_record_id IS NULL OR TRIM(m.follow_record_id) = '' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follow_up_record f WHERE f.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.follow_record_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND f.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = m.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci ) ) ) THEN NULL ELSE #{latestFollowRecordId} END, s.error_message = NULL, s.update_user = #{operatorUserId}, s.update_time = #{now} WHERE s.id = #{sessionDayId} AND s.organization_id = #{organizationId}
mapper.delete: DELETE rel FROM wecom_ingestion_message_follow_record rel JOIN wecom_ingestion_message msg ON msg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = rel.message_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND msg.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = rel.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE rel.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND msg.session_day_id = #{sessionDayId}

DELETE media FROM wecom_ingestion_media media JOIN wecom_ingestion_message msg ON (media.message_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = msg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR media.event_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = msg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) WHERE msg.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND msg.session_day_id = #{sessionDayId}
